```yaml
name: Java GSDK Unit Tests

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'java/**'

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up JDK 8
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: '8'

      - name: Grant execute permission for gradlew
        run: chmod +x gradlew

      - name: Build and test Java GSDK
        run: ./gradlew :gameserverSDK:test
```
